title.narrative: Designing and Financing Urban Water Resilience: An Inclusive Approach

description.narrative:
Cities are on the frontlines of the climate crisis, emitting more than 70 percent of global greenhouse gases as well as facing risks ranging from rising sea levels to deadly storms. Water, as both a unifying force and a catalyst for change, plays a crucial role in addressing these challenges. It underlies many of the issues cities face, from climate adaptation to sustainable development, and can drive transformative change when managed effectively.
Moreover, water offers multifaceted opportunities in addressing climate and urban challenges, from ecological restoration to public health and social economic development. By investing wisely in urban water, we can unlock solutions that address the interconnected challenges we face, making water a key leverage point for sustainable urban futures.
Water as Leverage, an initiative by the Netherlands in 2018, is a proven approach for catalysing just and sustainable urban water and climate resilience. It is an inclusive design-driven approach to develop, finance and implement projects that cut across sectoral and administrative boundaries, thereby across SDG’s.
